{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''Spartzen''''' was a [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90]] [[Corvette/Legends|Corvette]] employed by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] as part of an assault force attacking an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|Frigate]] ''[[Laantis]]'' while it was receiving a new [[Hyperdrive/Legends|Hyperdrive]] engine from the [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Rasvin]]''. The corvette, along with the rest of the Rebels was destroyed in the battle.

==Behind the scenes==
'''Spartzen''', along with the ''[[Glaser]]'' and the [[Chiller (CR90 corvette)|''Chiller'']] and a number of [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]] that escort the corvettes, are purple in the CMD. However, there is no indication of who they belong to other then the Rebels.

'''Spartzen''' only appears in "Hard" difficulty.
